cases.assertion_result: Actual canonical full-wet natural assembly has 21 raw/weighted rows, holds exactly columns 1 and 2, retains ordered original columns other than 1 and 2, preserves both nonzero drainage columns 5 and 11, reconstructs every weighted entry from raw/normalizer/scale bits, and preserves full-versus-reduced objective and norm bits.

Actual six-role provenance is [upper/lower sun, shade, stem] with exact structural-area and wet-fraction bits. Each held decision equals the complete formula/zero-column/current-free certificate; the structural-zero upper-sun role is excluded.
Both M=Cliq/2 and M=next_down(Cliq) produce 0<fwet<1, empty holds and exact 6 role, 252 entry and 21 mask work; no near-full tolerance admission occurs.
The actual structural-zero upper-sun anchor retains its ordinary identity row, is not BVLS05-held, and completes the expected empty-certificate work.

The prescribed selected direction yields upper Mixed/Drainage and lower Ice/Drainage. Initial natural, selected and dry new-base assemblies are fresh; identical-J retry preserves raw-J/base bits and held mask, performs zero role/column rescans and exactly one 21-mask join. Counts are two natural assemblies including new base, one selected assembly and three raw-J assemblies; input/trial remain unchanged.

Full-to-half-capacity uses two actual evaluator entries and one domain check, produces finite 21 residuals and positive finite normalizers, remains a nonroot without an acceptance claim, recomputes 0<fwet<1, changes residual bits and admits no inherited hold on the fresh dry assembly.

Half-to-full-capacity uses the same actual evaluator/domain/full-residual path, recomputes exact fwet=1 without a root-acceptance claim, starts from an empty hold and certifies exactly columns 1 and 2 only on the subsequent fresh full assembly.
